systems.name: 1.1 Game State Machine
systems.notes: Define and implement the core state machine: Lobby → Descent → Chapter Play → Chapter End → Campfire. Must track PlayerStatus (Alive, Ghost, Mimic-Disguised) and DungeonState per chapter.
tasks: Implement game phase transitions (Campfire → Descent → Play → End)
Track PlayerStatus enum per player (Alive, Ghost, Mimic-Disguised)
Track DungeonState (rooms cleared, objectives, chapter progress)

systems.name: 1.2 Top-Down Grid & LOS System
systems.notes: Build the top-down grid map with dynamic lighting and line-of-sight. Party members have limited LOS; the Mimic has global map visibility.
tasks: Implement grid-based map rendering (tile-based or canvas)
Build LOS system: raycasting or shadow-casting per player
Party LOS: limited radius, blocked by walls and doors
Mimic LOS: full map visibility toggle
Dynamic lighting: torches, darkness, flickering effects

systems.name: 1.3 Proximity-Based Communication System
systems.notes: Implement proximity voice/text chat. Living players hear each other based on distance. Ghosts have a separate channel. The Mimic can eavesdrop on all living communication.
tasks: Proximity voice chat for living players (distance-based volume)
Separate Ghost chat channel (all ghosts can communicate)
Mimic eavesdrop: receives all living player voice/text
Campfire lobby: open communication for all, Mimic hidden listener

systems.name: 1.4 Persistence & Save System
systems.notes: Persist campaign state across chapters: SkullCount, player gear, Mimic learned tactics, chapter progression.
tasks: Track Mimic's learned player tactics (observed behaviours)
